xnli.name: xnli
xnli.spec: facebook/xnli per-language parquet; text = premise + ' </s> ' + hypothesis; label = {0:entailment,1:neutral,2:contradiction}; en train -> de/fr/es.

pawsx.name: pawsx
pawsx.spec: google-research-datasets/paws-x dirs en,de,es,fr; text = sentence1 + ' </s> ' + sentence2; label {0,1}; en train -> de/fr/es.

textdetox.name: textdetox
textdetox.spec: textdetox/multilingual_toxicity_dataset default config; SPLIT NAMES are langs (columns text/toxic); stratified 80/20 train/test per language; en -> it/de/fr/es.

sib200.name: sib200
sib200.spec: Davlan/sib200 per-language TSV (cols index_id/category/text); single-label topic; en eng_Latn -> deu/fra/spa Latn; full train/test (701/204).
